tests.code: let a = AtomicU32::new(5); store_max(&a, 3); assert_eq!(a.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 5); store_max(&a, 9); assert_eq!(a.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 9);

let a = AtomicU32::new(0); thread::scope(|s| { for n in 0..8u32 { let a = &a; s.spawn(move || { for v in 0..2000 { store_max(a, n * 10_000 + v); } }); } }); assert_eq!(a.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 71_999);
